verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core framework is built around delegating tasks to AI agents: Tasks are assigned to Agents (docs-2/34), agents can 'Delegate tasks when allowed' and 'collaborate with other agents' (docs-46), and tools support 'delegating tasks among coworkers' (docs-6/23), with hierarchical process management explicitly supporting delegation chains (docs-3/48). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically validating delegation-quality/reliability in production use (community threads focus on other aspects like email agent risk, not delegation mechanics), and delegation requires developer configuration rather than being a ready-made single assistant.
